experiment.topic: BTC-USD relative strength vs SPY hourly
experiment.hypothesis: When BTC-USD’s 12-hour relative strength to SPY exceeds 5% above its 12-hour mean, BTC-USD will trend higher in the next hour.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If BTC-USD's 12-hour relative strength to SPY is below 5% of its 12-hour mean, and BTC-USD closes the next hour lower than the previous hour's close, then the hypothesis is falsified.
